First public release of **wefact-mcp**: a local MCP server that lets Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client work in your [WeFact](https://www.wefact.nl) administration through plain language.

> "List all outstanding invoices older than 30 days, grouped by customer."
> "Create a draft invoice for DB10000 with one line 'Monthly hosting' at €25."
> "Mark invoice 2026010001 as paid today, bank transfer."

## What's in it

**18 tools**
- Debtors: `list_debtors`, `get_debtor`, `create_debtor`, `update_debtor`
- Invoices: `list_invoices`, `get_invoice`, `create_invoice`, `send_invoice`, `credit_invoice`, `mark_invoice_paid`
- Products: `list_products`, `get_product`
- Subscriptions: `list_subscriptions`, `get_subscription`
- Purchase invoices (WeFact `creditinvoice`): `list_credit_invoices`, `get_credit_invoice`
- `whoami` connection check and `wefact_request` — a generic escape hatch for every other WeFact controller/action (price quotes, reminders, PDF download, bank transactions, tasks, settings, ...).

**Field names 1:1 with the WeFact docs.** `DebtorCode`, `InvoiceLines`, `PriceExcl`, `TaxCode` — copy parameter names straight from developer.wefact.com. Nested data is passed as JSON and encoded into WeFact's `InvoiceLines[0][ProductCode]` form notation.

**Safe by default**
- `create_invoice` always creates a concept (Status 0); nothing is sent.
- `send_invoice` and `credit_invoice` refuse without `confirm=true`, so the model must ask you first.
- HTTP 403 (IP blocked) is never retried; network errors, 429 and 5xx are retried with exponential backoff.
- Every failure returns a structured error object the model can act on.

**Built for real administrations**
- Pagination walks all pages at WeFact's maximum page size (1000): 10 000 debtors = 10 calls.
- 33 tests, no network needed; CI on Python 3.10 and 3.12.
- Condensed WeFact v2 API reference in `docs/wefact-api-reference.md`.

**Local only.** The server runs on your machine over stdio. Your API key lives in a local `.env` and only travels to `api.mijnwefact.nl`. No telemetry, no intermediate server.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/BE-Zizoo/wefact-mcp.git && cd wefact-mcp
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate   # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env   # add WEFACT_API_KEY
```

Then add the server to your MCP client — see the [README](https://github.com/BE-Zizoo/wefact-mcp#configure-your-mcp-client) or the Dutch step-by-step guide in [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/BE-Zizoo/wefact-mcp/blob/main/INSTALL.md).

## Good to know

- WeFact's `creditinvoice` controller holds **purchase invoices**. Credit notes you issue to customers are invoices with `Status` 8 → `list_invoices(status=8)`.
- Invoice statuses: `0` concept, `2` sent, `3` partly paid, `4` paid, `8` credit invoice, `9` expired.
- WeFact's API is IPv4-only and requires your IP on the whitelist under Settings → API.
